text:
alex.k: oob PXE guard tripped during rack-7 firmware push. Interlock prevented BIOS write on 6 nodes, now stuck in provisioning. anyone oncall?

maria.s: I'm seeing this too. BMCs return `interlock: firmware_write_blocked` and PXE_GUARD logs show spoofed MACs.

cheng: This aligns with the PXE-guard we rolled last week (oob-controller v2.3.1). Did we run the updated arp-protector ruleset?

alex.k: I think canary hit rack-7. We should either rollback controller or temporarily disable guard for rack-7. If nodes stay offline >2h we'll impact Dedicated GPU commit.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: firmware-rollout job fw-20260401 started for rack-7 (6 nodes). job status: failed at step 'write-bios' on 6/6

maria.s: tried `oobctl clear-interlock rack-7 --force` -> `error: BMC busy: provisioning session active`.

cheng: run `oobctl bmc-logs rack-7 --filter PXE_GUARD` and paste top lines

maria.s: logs:
```
[2026-04-01T14:02:13Z] PXE_GUARD: SPOOF_DETECTED src_mac=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01 src_ip=10.0.7.12 iface=mgmt0
[2026-04-01T14:02:13Z] INTERLOCK: firmware_write_blocked reason=pxe_spoof
[2026-04-01T14:02:14Z] PROVISION: session_start id=prov-8a
```

alex.k: plan proposal:
1) pause fw rollout
2) disable pxe_guard for rack-7: `oobctl set pxe_guard=false --racks rack-7`
3) re-run fw job on rack-7
4) re-enable guard and run canary on rack-9

maria.s: starting step 2

oncall-bot: ack alex.k

maria.s: disable command returned success on 4 nodes, two BMCs still refuse: `error: tpm_lock active, cannot change pxe_guard`

cheng: tpm_lock suggests BIOS-level attestation; those two may have had attestation keys present and secure-boot state mismatch. need manual serial/ILO cycle.

alex.k: can we hot-spare capacity? If we lose these 2 nodes for >4h we'll hit USW3 capacity commit. Suggest cold-swap to spare nodes in us-west-3 and bump autoscaler.

ops-bot: autoscaler: increased desired GPU capacity by 8 in us-west-3 to cover immediate load

maria.s: I kicked remote serial to the two nodes, performed manual ILO reboot, cleared tpm_lock, re-applied disable. Now firmware write succeeded on both.

alex.k: fw push re-run: success on all 6. re-enabling pxe_guard on rack-7 now.

cheng: re-enable complete. will schedule follow-up: runbook update for 'PXE_GUARD interlock during firmware rollout' + postmortem.

maria.s: adding to runbook: add pre-rollout check for attestation state + a canary isolation for oob-controller upgrades.

alex.k: thanks team. filing incident ticket: INC-20260401-006. ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260401-006

alex.k: assigning to eng-infra + eng-runtime for kernel selection review.

cheng: noted. I'll own the postmortem and runbook edits.

maria.s: closing thread once incident is triaged.
